_comment: Captures Chez at its strongest vs capped Stockfish. threads=4 (Lazy SMP) because strength is hugely thread-sensitive (baseline measured 0.56@1t -> 0.89@2t vs SF_2400); 4t x conc3 = 15/16 cores, clean timing. Ladder shifted up + SF_2400 dropped: at >=2 threads baseline already beat SF_2400 +24-2 (saturated, ~uninformative, +/-249 Elo); informative cells are where Chez scores 30-70%. rounds=100 (200 games/opp) -> ~+/-50 Elo CI. Balanced 8moves book for representative absolute Elo + lower variance. SF kept at Threads=1: with UCI_LimitStrength its skill is fixed by UCI_Elo regardless of threads. SF UCI_Elo caps at 3190; if Chez sweeps 3190, swap the top rung for fixed-NODES full-strength SF (UCI_LimitStrength=false, e.g. nodes=200000).
